definitions.gloss: dead drunk; heavily intoxicated; blind drunk
definitions.explanation: A state of extreme drunkenness where one can barely function. Stronger than just being drunk — implies a complete loss of composure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泥酔|でいすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動|うご}けなかった→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: He was dead drunk and couldn't move.

examples.japanese: {泥酔|でいすい}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいた。
examples.english: There was someone passed out drunk on the station platform.

examples.japanese: {泥酔|でいすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暴|あば}れて→暴れる：04575_abareru⟧、⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{困|こま}っていた→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: A dead-drunk passenger was being rowdy in the taxi, and the driver was at a loss.

notes:
Literally "mud-drunk" — the ⟦{泥|どろ}→泥：03492_doro⟧ (mud) character evokes the image of someone so drunk they are like mud, completely limp and unable to function. The verb form {泥酔|でいすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to get completely wasted."

DEGREES OF DRUNKENNESS (from mild to severe):
- ⟦ほろ{酔|よ}い→ほろ酔い：09370_horoyoi⟧ (pleasantly tipsy)
- ⟦{酔|よ}っている→酔う：14437_you⟧ (drunk)
- {泥酔|でいすい} (dead drunk)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泥酔|でいすい}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (state of heavy intoxication)
- {泥酔|でいすい}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (driving while heavily intoxicated)
- {泥酔|でいすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (extremely drunk customer/patron)
